replies.author: imryaan
replies.body:
I like your concept although I feel that for a public match (16v16 - 24v24) it looks to small.
I recommend that you should fatten the lanes for more pvp space and add a few more structures but don't overdo it. Regarding the colours, change them to something else as they're just a bit boring. Adding onto that, add some more design to the lanes (like a pattern or something) because they look rather plain.

Anyways, good job with your map.

You may resubmit when these edits are made.
